outreach_draft.subject: A thought on your Entertainment Law section
outreach_draft.body:
Bruce,

I noticed your site speaks to three very different kinds of clients—Criminal Law, Entertainment Law, and Wrongful Death—but they currently share the same general homepage experience. Entertainment Law especially feels like its own conversation: an artist or creator dealing with contracts, masters, registrations, or royalty disputes is arriving with very different questions from someone facing a criminal charge or a family dealing with a wrongful death.

A focused Entertainment Law page could:
- speak directly to creators and entertainment clients
- give Google a focused page to crawl and index
- give AI tools clearer context around that part of your practice

You already explain the core entertainment issues clearly on the homepage, so I’m using that as the first mockup example.

I’m putting together a quick mockup to show you what I mean. I’ll send it over in the next couple of days.

If you’d rather I didn’t, just let me know.
